title: BNT vs non-BNT at their de-biasing cuts (MOPED, single seed)
note: As the pooled version, but each arm shows its single most representative NDE seed (chosen by scripts/tension/seeds.py against the median, on both centre and width) rather than all seeds concatenated. This is the object a real survey reports: one trained density estimator, its own posterior. Ratio 1.211x here versus 1.270x pooled; the difference is seed selection, not physics, because the two arms draw their representatives independently. Prefer the pooled figure when quoting a ratio.
